methodology.classificationScope: Runtime rendering only; scientific validity was not assessed.
methodology.directNavigation: Each attempt used a fresh Playwright page navigated directly to record.embedUrl.
methodology.resultFrameRequirement: Verification required an attached JSFiddle result iframe and inspection of its document; the shell response alone was insufficient.
methodology.meaningfulContent: Non-empty visible body text, a visible canvas/svg/img/video/audio, or another visible non-script body descendant.
methodology.pageErrors: Any uncaught pageerror observed before inspection changed meaningful output to rendered-with-errors.
methodology.failedRequests: requestfailed events were retained; Cloudflare analytics/beacon failures were excluded from runtime failure counts and stored separately.
methodology.retryPolicy: Every first attempt not classified verified was retried once with a fresh page; the second attempt is the record classification.

inspection.bodyTextSample:
ESU Electron (no spin 1/2) — lattice displacement ansatz
We visualize a spherically symmetric “electron-like” configuration in an elastic solid: a static eigenstrain tail (long-range, non-radiating) plus an optional localized breather / standing mode that oscillates in time but remains spatially confined (a “bound mode” ansatz).

u_total = u_charge(r) + u_bound(r,t)   |   pressure proxy p ∝ −∇·u
Mode: eigenstrain + bound oscillator
Compression colors: ∇·u
Phase colors: ωt (+ π if node sign flips

records.title: ESU — Electron (no spin 1/2): spherically symmetric eigenstrain + oscillation

inspection.bodyTextSample:
ESU — “Electron” (no spin 1/2): eigenstrain bulge + spherically symmetric oscillation
Displacement ansatz (radial, orientation-free):
u(x,t) = uQ(r) r̂ + uosc(r) cos(ωt+φ₀) r̂
Pressure proxy (for coloring option): p ∝ −∇·u
This is a visual / analytic displacement model (ansatz), not a full elastodynamic PDE solve. Models include non-radiating-looking “quasi-static”/evanescent/compact breathers + an optional radiating comparison.
RADIAL PROFILE (Uᵣ AND −∇·U)

Point color = oscillator phase (from u & v)
